task_instruction: Finish the card dragging mechanic for the alternate harness. The provided `res://scenes/main.tscn` harness keeps three `CardUI` instances under `OverlayUI/Rack`, and each card should continue using the existing `CardStateMachine`, `CardBaseState`, `CardClickedState`, and `CardDraggingState` nodes from `res://scenes/card_ui/card_ui.tscn`. In `res://scenes/card_ui/card_state_machine.gd`, initialize every child state, connect each state's `transition_requested` signal, enter the exported `initial_state`, and forward `_input` and `gui_input` to the active state while ignoring transition requests that do not come from the current state. In `res://scenes/card_ui/card_ui.gd`, call `card_state_machine.init(self)` in `_ready()`, forward the existing input callbacks into the state machine, and keep `targets` updated from the `DropPointDetector` area enter/exit callbacks without duplicates. In the card state scripts, make the base state emit `reparent_requested`, reset `DropPointDetector.monitoring` to `false`, and move to the clicked state on left-click, make the clicked state record `original_index`, enable `DropPointDetector.monitoring`, and transition to dragging on mouse motion, make the dragging state reparent the card into the node in the `card_layer` group, follow the mouse, cancel back to base on right-click, and only confirm release after `DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD := 0.08` has elapsed, and make the released state immediately remove the card when `targets` is not empty but otherwise go back to base on the next input. In `res://scenes/ui/hand.gd`, connect each new card's `reparent_requested` signal and restore cancelled drags back into `Rack` at their recorded index.

+extends SceneTree

+	call_deferred("run")

+func run() -> void:
+	var main = load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
+	root.add_child(main)
+	await process_frame
+	await process_frame
+
+	var rack = main.get_node("OverlayUI/Rack")
+	assert(rack.get_child_count() == 3)
+	var card = rack.get_child(1)
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == 0)
+
+	var card_center = card.global_position + card.size / 2.0
+	card._on_gui_input(_mouse_button(card_center, MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, true))
+	await process_frame
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == 1)
+
+	card._input(_mouse_motion(card_center + Vector2(10, -10)))
+	await process_frame
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == 2)
+	assert(card.get_parent() == main.get_node("OverlayUI"))
+
+	card._input(_mouse_button(card_center + Vector2(10, -10), MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT, true))
+	await process_frame
+	assert(card.card_state_machine.current_state.state == 0)
+	assert(card.get_parent() == rack)
+	assert(card.get_index() == 1)
+
+	card_center = card.global_position + card.size / 2.0
+	card._on_gui_input(_mouse_button(card_center, MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, true))
+	card._input(_mouse_motion(Vector2(124, 54)))
+	await create_timer(0.1).timeout
+	card._on_drop_point_detector_area_entered(main.get_node("ResolveArea"))
+	assert(not card.targets.is_empty())
+	card._input(_mouse_button(Vector2(124, 54), MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, false))
+	await process_frame
+	assert(not is_instance_valid(card))
+	assert(rack.get_child_count() == 2)
+
+	print("drag mechanic integration test passed")
+	quit()
+

+	var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
+	event.position = position
+	event.global_position = position
+	event.button_index = button
+	event.pressed = pressed
+	return event
+
+
+func _mouse_motion(position: Vector2) -> InputEventMouseMotion:
+	var event := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
+	event.position = position
+	event.global_position = position
+	return event

 extends "res://scenes/card_ui/card_states/card_state.gd"
 
 const DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD := 0.08
+
+var drag_started_at := 0
+
+
+func enter() -> void:
+	drag_started_at = Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	var card_layer: Node = card_ui.get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("card_layer")
+	card_ui.reparent(card_layer)
+	card_ui.global_position = card_ui.get_global_mouse_position() - card_ui.pivot_offset
+	card_ui.state_label.text = "Dragging"
+
+
+func on_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
+		card_ui.global_position = card_ui.get_global_mouse_position() - card_ui.pivot_offset
+
+	if event.is_action_pressed("right_mouse"):
+		transition_requested.emit(self, State.BASE)
+	elif event.is_action_released("left_mouse") and _minimum_drag_time_elapsed():
+		transition_requested.emit(self, State.RELEASED)
+
+
+func _minimum_drag_time_elapsed() -> bool:
+	return Time.get_ticks_msec() - drag_started_at >= DRAG_MINIMUM_THRESHOLD * 1000.0
